steps.content: After dealing with these dragon-like Corruptors, you still haven't found the whereabouts of the bowstring.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: How strange... But the poem literally says "rushed from the east, peered to the west."

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Go east... check. Look west... check.
Standing next to the dead Corruptors, Yanyan flips through the myth book from start to end several times.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mmmm... Maybe I should try divining again? This time we will definitely find it!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Drops from heaven, pray be hastened... Oops, that's not what I'm asking.
(Weird sounds...)

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: When peril hit, in hills all hid... Eh, that doesn't seem right either?
Yanyan concentrates on spinning the divination wheel in her hands, completely unaware of the changes happening around her.
The dead Corruptor suddenly comes back to life. Lifting its head, it makes to devour the human before it.
It all happens too suddenly. The monster's gaping maw is already wide open, yet you and the FAC soldiers can't reach Yanyan in time.
A burst of golden light suddenly appears on the monster's body. It begins struggling in pain and collapses to the ground.
You run over to scoop up the petrified Yanyan and signal the FAC to quickly contain the situation.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Eh? Eh! What happened...
Yanyan seems to have calmed down when the Corruptor stops moving after being blasted by the FAC's bullets. Only then does she notice what happened around her just now.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is this...
In the lifeless dragon's body, you see a wriggling thread with a reddish-gold glow slip into the carcass like a parasite.
Did that thing interrupt the monster's revival? You look at the red worm, pondering.

It feels different from the Apostles of Ashes you've encountered before. After the Corruptor disappears, you don't feel any aggression. Instead, there's a strange sense of familiarity, as if you've seen this red flame somewhere.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is this... the dragon's vein?
Yanyan examines the worm curiously with the magnifying glass in her hand.
Reciting some incomprehensible poetry, she approaches it with a glass jar she picked up from the banks of the Rust.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Great dragon slain, bright glory claimed... Heh!
Yanyan grabs the long worm from the carcass of the Corruptor and puts it into the glass jar.
Having seen Yanyan touch the contamination at the High Tower Black Ring, the FAC soldiers are no longer surprised by her actions. But this is definitely against every rule they've been accustomed to.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, look, isn't it kinda cute?
The object in the bottle emits a faint golden glow. Yanyan lifts it to your face excitedly, eager to show you the bowstring.
You quickly wave your hands to refuse, but as soon as you stretch out your hand, a series of visions appear before your eyes.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Analysis shows that this substance does not belong to DisCity and has the power to suppress the Black Ring Apostle's kin.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Continue the mission and move up the security priority of the Sunsink City's seer.
After conducting a detailed analysis on the dragon's vein acquired and consolidating the intelligence, Schorl assigns you the next phase of the mission.
Both the Sunsink City's seer and its myths still present contradictions and questionable points.
But her unique psychic abilities have repeatedly suggested that perhaps she really can create the Almighty Bow and end the disaster.
The persistent low fever is still ravaging your body. The omens brought by the Sun Crow Apostle are becoming more apparent, and the time left for you seems to be running out.
